name: terminal-byte-audit-v2
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,base64,subprocess,sys,datetime
p=Path.cwd();h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def write(n,b):
 if isinstance(b,str):b=b.encode()
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n,'--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(b).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
expected='050ba51fc168084d5381bcff4d0466844a2fed221416847c0fe13e7b8c8f8cb5'
assert (p/'HANDBACK.md').is_file() and h((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes())==expected
assert expected in (p/'reservation.sha256').read_text()
ids=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids'];r=json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text());prov=json.loads((p/'raw-provenance.json').read_text())['records']
assert len(r)==20 and set(r)==set(prov)==set(map(str,ids))
chunks={};literal=[]
for i in ids:
 v=prov[str(i)];f=Path(v['chunk_path'])
 assert f.parent==p.parents[1]/'lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus'
 if str(f) not in chunks:
  b=f.read_bytes();chunks[str(f)]={'sha256':h(b),'lines':b.splitlines(keepends=True)}
 c=chunks[str(f)];assert c['sha256']==v['chunk_sha256']
 b=c['lines'][v['line_1based']-1];assert b==base64.b64decode(v['raw_base64']) and h(b)==v['raw_sha256']
 assert b[len(b.rstrip(b'\r\n')):].hex()==v['newline_hex']
 o=json.loads(b);assert o==v['object'] and o['mathdb_id']==i
 assert h(b.rstrip(b'\r\n'))==v['object_original_bytes_sha256']
 assert h(json.dumps(o,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode())==v['object_canonical_json_sha256']
 assert h(o['statement'].encode())==v['statement_sha256'] and o['statement']==r[str(i)]['literal_statement']
 assert r[str(i)]['credit']==0
 assert set(r[str(i)]['gates'])=={'fidelity','mathematics','prior','novelty','significance','formal','independent_review','acceptance'}
 literal.append(b)
write('literal-records.jsonl',b''.join(literal))
receipts=[]
for f in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 o=json.loads(f.read_text());assert o['killed'] is None
 if o['exit']!=0:assert f.name=='terminal-byte-audit.receipt.json' and o['exit']==1
 receipts.append({'file':f.name,'sha256':h(f.read_bytes()),'exit':o['exit'],'killed':o['killed'],'wall_s':o['wall_s'],'child_cpu_cumulative_s':o['child_cpu_cumulative_s'],'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':o['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'samples':o['samples'],'stderr':o['stderr']})
resources=json.loads((p/'resource-inventory.json').read_text());resources['completed_runner_receipts']=receipts
resources['terminal_audit_correction']='terminal-byte-audit exited1 because its guard expected9 gates instead of the eight explicitly requested gates; actual results had correct eight gates. No source/proof mutation. Failed receipt retained. v2 checks exact gate-name set and preserves actual exit1, not an unchanged retry.'
resources['cutoff']='All completed receipts before terminal-byte-audit-v2 included; current v2 output/receipt written only after child exits; explicit noncircular boundary.'
write('resource-inventory.json',json.dumps(resources,indent=2))
brief=(p/'BRIEF.md').read_text()
brief += '\nAudit correction: terminal-byte-audit exited1 on an erroneous nine-gate-count guard; the requested eight named gates were present. Failed receipt retained. terminal-byte-audit-v2 checks the exact eight-name set. The v2 audit includes the failed receipt and all earlier completed receipts; only its own evolving output/receipt and manifest self-hash are excluded. No source/proof failure was hidden.\n'
write('BRIEF.md',brief)
write('HANDBACK.md',(p/'HANDBACK.md').read_text()+'\nTerminal audit v1 guard-count error retained; corrected v2 exact-set validation follows this amended handback. All eight requested gates are separate. No source/proof mutation.\n')
assert h((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes())==expected
write('reservation-checks.json',json.dumps({'expected_sha256':expected,'before_extraction':'extract-twenty asserted reservation.json SHA and reservation.sha256 BEFORE opening corpus','after_handback_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'after_handback_sha256':h((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes()),'reservation_sha256_file_hash':h((p/'reservation.sha256').read_bytes()),'exact_records_verified':20,'chunks_verified':[{'path':s,'sha256':v['sha256']} for s,v in chunks.items()],'original_JSONL_bytes_objects_newlines_statement_hashes':'all matched actual original corpus bytes','literal_records_file':'literal-records.jsonl; original records concatenated in reservation order without normalization'},indent=2))
exclusions={'manifest.json':'Cannot contain its own bytes/hash noncircularly.','terminal-byte-audit-v2.receipt.json':'Current supervisor receipt written after child exits; cannot prehash it without endless verification chain. Actual terminal exit returned by runner.','terminal-byte-audit-v2.output.txt':'Current evolving stdout written by supervisor after child exits; explicit terminal boundary.'}
files=[]
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if not f.is_file():continue
 assert f.resolve().is_relative_to(p)
 rel=str(f.relative_to(p))
 if rel in exclusions:continue
 b=f.read_bytes();files.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':h(b)})
manifest={'schema':'actual-byte-sha256-v1','utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'reservation_sha256':expected,'files':files,'explicit_self_exclusions':exclusions,'receipts_included':[x['path'] for x in files if x['path'].endswith('receipt.json')],'limits':'Only own lane; includes bootstrap and all completed receiptJSONs at start, including failed v1 audit. No manifest self-hash or future receipt-hash claim.'}
write('manifest.json',json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
for x in json.loads((p/'manifest.json').read_text())['files']:
 b=(p/x['path']).read_bytes();assert len(b)==x['bytes'] and h(b)==x['sha256']
assert h((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes())==expected
print(json.dumps({'verification':'PASS after amended standalone handback','exact_records':len(r),'gate_names_verified':8,'actual_byte_files_verified':len(files),'completed_receipt_JSONs_included':len(manifest['receipts_included']),'manifest_sha256':h((p/'manifest.json').read_bytes()),'reservation_sha256':expected,'self_exclusions':exclusions,'jobs':'All joined subprocesses reaped; supplied supervisor communicates/reaps this final child before returning','credit':0,'campaign':'52/60 unchanged'},indent=2))
